The '''Poisonwater Mining Operation''' was a valley on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Quesh]] that was the site of several mining operations during the [[Galactic War]], a conflict fought between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Poisonwater Mining Operation appears on Quesh in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]].<ref name="TOR" />
